content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms often impose significant fees and restrictions that can cripple your ability to sell digital products. For example, Gumroad takes a hefty 10% on every sale, which can add up quickly. With COREMERCH, you only pay a 0.5% fee through NOWPayments, preserving your earnings. This infrastructure is built to operate independently of these restrictive platforms, ensuring that you have the sovereignty to run your business without relying on external services that can change their policies anytime. By utilizing blockchain technology, you can process payments securely and efficiently, making it a robust solution for creators in underserved markets.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can start selling, you’ll need to gather the essential tools for deployment. First, ensure you have a reliable domain name and hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which are free. Next, set up a backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will help automate order processing and delivery. You will also need a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for managing orders and an effective file delivery system via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, establish your payment system using NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This setup will lay the foundation for a successful digital commerce operation.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To streamline your sales process, integrate NOWPayments into your store. This service allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, with minimal transaction fees. Set your products’ prices in USD, and NOWPayments will automatically convert the crypto payment at the time of the transaction. This ensures you receive the exact amount you need without worrying about fluctuating exchange rates. For delivery, automate the process using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to send digital products instantly after payment confirmation. This way, you can focus on creating while the system handles transactions and deliveries seamlessly.
Save 9.5% on every sale by using NOWPayments instead of traditional platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Double-check that all integrations are functioning correctly, from payment processing to product delivery. Create a test product and simulate a purchase to confirm that the entire pipeline works as expected. Once you verify everything, promote your store through social media, email, or content marketing to attract potential customers. Encourage feedback to ensure a smooth experience for your buyers. Processing your first transaction successfully will provide you invaluable insights into how your system operates under real-world conditions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is up and running, consider scaling your operations. Start by expanding your product range and adding more digital offerings, such as courses, templates, or plugins. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can help you enhance your store's functionality. Analyze customer behavior and sales data using your order storage solution to make informed decisions about product development and marketing strategies. Automate repetitive tasks using advanced backend logic to free up time for content creation and customer engagement. This proactive approach will help you grow your digital commerce business sustainably.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can leverage cryptocurrency payment solutions like NOWPayments integrated with your own digital store setup. This allows for lower transaction fees and instant delivery, ensuring you retain more profits. With your own sovereignty setup, you can manage sales without restrictions imposed by traditional platforms.
Automate your sales pipeline to focus more on creating and less on logistics.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain name and set up hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for managing orders. Prepare a file delivery method via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Test your setup with a sample product before going live.
